sentences.en: Politeness is just a protocol that is different in every society.
sentences.zh: 1. 礼貌在每个社会中都是不同的礼仪规范。

sentences.en: Industrial countries must reduce environmental pollution and sign the Kyoto Protocol.
sentences.zh: 2. 工业国家必须减少环境污染并签署《京都议定书》。

sentences.en: Anyone who considers protocol unimportant has never dealt with a cat.
sentences.zh: 3. 认为礼仪不重要的人都没有和猫打过交道。
